Published:

NEW YORK—Observing that the search for nirvana was futile, onlookers confirmed Tuesday that the pack of teens moving between subway cars must not realize that enlightenment lies wherever they are. “These kids can spend the whole train ride moving from car to car, but they’ll be no closer to finding the inner peace they seek,” said fellow passenger Angela Azar, noting that the boisterous group of high schoolers reminded her of restless ghosts who bother the living because they are trapped, unable to move on to a higher realm. “Don’t these teens know that this car and each subsequent car they enter offers no more answers than the one where they began this journey? If they simply sat down on the first seat they saw, they could finally realize that the answers to the all the questions of the universe are within us. When they reach the end of the train, they’ll understand that their wandering was in vain and that they’ve wasted the entire trip seeking what wasn’t there.” Nearby passengers later added that the young group would never reach a state of tranquility if they insisted on continuing to play TikTok videos at full volume.
